name: Alphalete - Meeting Notes 2026-10-21
body:
> Report · Alphalete · 2026-10-21

# Summary
Notes from a 46-minute Google Meet (recorded in Fathom) between the SEO Specialist and the Agency owner on Oct 21 2026. Purpose: review the new monthly SEO performance report and align on local SEO strategy. The file sits in the Alphalete folder but covers all clients; it also includes a Summit Plumbing lead analysis.

# Key takeaways
1. **Report redesign:** lead with business outcomes (leads, jobs, revenue) and high-level strategy; technical detail, challenge lists and task logs go to an appendix or separate tab. More charts. Keep the branded vs non-branded split. Plain language (an example of an unclear line was "match the services hub title, heading and copy to trenchless sewer repair"). Deliver as a self-contained email, not a link. Reports generate on the 2nd of each month; data starts June 2026.
2. **GBP access approved** for the SEO Specialist, with limits: do not change business descriptions; check before adding products.
3. **GBP Offer posts:** use the Offer type (title, description, dates, image, redeem link) linked to a single-service landing page; image is an edited promo graphic (real photo preferred; Higgsfield or ChatGPT acceptable); run to a set end date. Summit example: "$100 off a new water heater".
4. **Alphalete specifically:** the GBP is still unverified, so Offer posts wait until the owners complete verification.
5. **Summit lead analysis:** phone staff asking about home warranties may steer callers to lower-paying warranty jobs; repeat customers should not count as new SEO wins. Lead source definitions recorded (Direct, Organic search, GBP).

# Action items
- SEO Specialist: redesign the SEO report; start GBP Offer posts within the access limits; review Summit call transcripts in tagCRM and report findings.
- Agency owner: share the Summit landing page spreadsheet (about 18 pages); remind the client to train phone staff on the warranty question.
